benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval Clean (FLEURS-R) · 9-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: ZTTS1-Eval Clean: 500 FLEURS-R read-speech utterances per language; zero-shot cloning where supported, preset voices otherwise. Qwen3-ASR scorer. Unweighted mean over en, zh, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, ru (hard_en/hard_zh excluded).
caveats: Preset-voice systems (ElevenLabs v3, Gemini) do not clone the prompt speaker.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval Clean (FLEURS-R) · 9-language mean MSR-UTMOS
benchmarks.setup: Same generations as ztts1-clean-ml9-wer; MSR-UTMOS (utmos22_strong) automatic naturalness prediction, unweighted mean over the nine languages.
benchmarks.display_unit: predicted MOS / 5; not human MOS, not accuracy
caveats: Automatic MOS predictor trained mainly on English; multilingual scores are indicative.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild · 10-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild set: spontaneous VoxBlink2 prompts (1,618 utterances, 17 languages). Qwen3-ASR scorer. Unweighted mean over the 10 languages every compared system supports: en, zh, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt, ru. No prompt audio imported.
caveats: Preset-voice systems do not clone the noisy prompt speaker; they read with a clean built-in voice.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild · 10-language mean MSR-UTMOS
benchmarks.setup: Same generations as ztts1-itw-10lang-wer; MSR-UTMOS mean over the same 10 languages.
benchmarks.display_unit: predicted MOS / 5; not human MOS, not accuracy

benchmarks.name: LEMAS multilingual TTS eval · 9-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: LEMAS-Dataset evaluation set, 500 utterances per language (3-15 s, alignment score > 0.9), zero-shot cloning; Paraformer-zh for Chinese, Whisper-large-v3 otherwise (Seed-TTS protocol). Mean over de,en,es,fr,id,it,pt,ru,zh as printed for OpenAudio-S1-Mini (vi excluded, no value).
caveats: Only one catalogued system; raw evidence, not a calibrated comparison.

benchmarks.name: Granite 5.0 report · Open ASR public 7-set mean WER
benchmarks.setup: IBM's own evaluation in arXiv:2609.20104v1 Table 3 on the public components of the Open ASR leaderboard: AMI, Earnings22, Gigaspeech, LibriSpeech clean, LibriSpeech other, SPGISpeech, VoxPopuli (7 sets, TED-LIUM absent). AVG is the unweighted mean of the seven per-set WERs. Report text states Table 5/6 used the 20 May 2026 leaderboard version; Table 3 set version assumed the same public components. Greedy CTC decoding. Not the 8-set March-2026 Open ASR CSV mix (open-asr-wer) and not the leaderboard's private Voice Arena set.
caveats: Lab self-report; single-model series in this source.
Table 3 row 'Robust fine tuning' is the final of three training stages described for the released model; the table does not print the Hugging Face revision.
Do not merge with open-asr-wer: different set mix (no TED-LIUM) and different evaluator.

results.note: Table 3 'Robust fine tuning' (final training stage) AVG WER 5.72% over AMI 8.32, Earnings22 8.54, Gigaspeech 9.93, LS-clean 1.32, LS-other 2.54, SPGI 3.35, VoxPopuli 6.03. Model granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc (470M CTC, greedy decoding). Earlier-stage rows (Base 5.83, LLM distillation 5.75) not imported.
